question: The 8th India Water Week 2024 was held during 17-20 September 2024, in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **8th India Water Week (IWW) 2024** was organized in **New Delhi**, the national capital of India. The event was held from **17th to 20th September 2024**.
 
• The theme for the 8th India Water Week 2024 was **“Water Security for Sustainable Development”**, focusing on the judicious use of water resources for sustainable economic development and environmental management.
 
• The event was organized by the **Ministry of Jal Shakti**, Government of India, in association with several national and international partners.
 
• India Water Week serves as a platform for **policymakers, experts, and stakeholders** from across the globe to discuss and collaborate on water management strategies and solutions.
 
• The event featured **exhibitions, workshops, and panel discussions** showcasing advancements in water conservation techniques, irrigation technologies, and water resource management.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **India Water Week:**

 
 
• India Water Week is a flagship event organized by the **Ministry of Jal Shakti** to address critical water-related issues and explore solutions for sustainable water management.
 
• It was first organized in **2012**, and since then, it has been held biennially, attracting participation from **national and international experts**, government officials, and industry leaders.
 
• The event focuses on themes such as **water conservation, irrigation, flood management, and wastewater treatment**.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Jal Shakti:**
 
 
• The **Ministry of Jal Shakti** was formed in **2019** by merging the Ministry of Water Resources, River Development, and Ganga Rejuvenation with the Ministry of Drinking Water and Sanitation.
 
• It is responsible for the **management of water resources**, including drinking water supply, water conservation, and river development projects.
 
• Key initiatives include the **Namami Gange Programme** and the **Jal Jeevan Mission**.
 
 
 
• **Water Security in India:**
 
 
• India is home to **17% of the world's population** but has only **4% of the world's freshwater resources**, making water security a critical concern.
 
• Challenges include **overexploitation of groundwater**, **water pollution**, and **climate change**-induced variations in water availability.
 
• Programs like the **Atal Bhujal Yojana** and the **National Water Mission** aim to address these issues.
 
 
 
• **Other Locations (Options):**
 
 
• **Bhopal:** Known for its lakes, Bhopal has hosted several national-level conferences on water management but is not the location for the 8th India Water Week.
 
• **Chandigarh:** While Chandigarh is a planned city with effective water management practices, it has not hosted the India Water Week 2024.
 
• **Mumbai:** As a coastal city, Mumbai faces challenges like waterlogging and sea-level rise, but is not the venue for this event.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of India Water Week:**

 
 
• It provides a platform to **promote integrated water resources management** and sustainable water use practices.
 
• The event helps in formulating **policies and strategies** for water-related challenges in India and globally.
 
 
 
• **International Cooperation:**
 
 
• Several international organizations, including the **United Nations**, the **World Bank**, and **FAO**, participate in the event, sharing best practices and technologies.
